about: Ranking of `momentry list --rank`, the web UI wall and the angle step's top N. A story goes to the first tier whose conditions all hold; inside a tier the higher score (sum of the adjustments that fire) comes first; equal scores fall to the tie-breakers. How to change a rule: docs/development.md.

tiers.why: A harvest run caught it and it has a real tension: the stories most often worth telling.
Tension none: an event, a tip or a chore; t less often than stories with a tension.
The tension step never scored it (missing tension): nothing to rank it by yet.
Found only by the outsider step: it retells a practice from the outside angle and is rarely t (2/20).
Found only by the outsider step and tension none.
Found only by the outsider step and never scored.

adjust.why: Stakes 0-3: how much the story changed the outcome of the session's main work. Added, not multiplied, so strength 0 (every tension none) does not erase it.
Strength 0-3 of the tension: how hard the hook pulls a reader on.
